content.readme:
# unslop

Created by Damir Sokolovsky ([@heydamir](https://x.com/heydamir)), who started the [Unslopping series](https://x.com/heydamir/status/2115063463063998736) on X.

![A vibecoded dashboard unslopping itself, frame by frame](skills/unslop/references/refs/story-dashboard-frames.webp)

unslop is a skill for Claude Code, Codex and Google Antigravity that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character. It finds the slop first, the purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy and uneven spacing, then sets a direction from your product and fixes the screen pass by pass like a designer doing a redline review. It works in whatever your screen is built with, like Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML and CSS, on dashboards, apps and landing pages, and even on a live site when all you have is a link.

## Install

For Claude Code, install it as a plugin. Run this in a terminal to get it in every project:

```bash
claude plugin install unslop --marketplace heydamir/unslop
```

On an older Claude Code without `--marketplace`, the same in two steps:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add heydamir/unslop
claude plugin install unslop@heydamir
```

To get it in a single project only, run the install from that project's root folder, the one you start Claude Code in, and add `--scope local`. To turn it on for everyone who works in the project, add `--scope project` instead and commit `.claude/settings.json`. Each teammate then runs this once in their own copy of the project:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add heydamir/unslop
claude plugin install unslop@heydamir --scope project
```

Then start a new Claude Code session, or run `/reload-plugins` in one that is already open.

To update, run `claude plugin update unslop@heydamir`, or turn on auto-update for the heydamir marketplace under Marketplaces in `/plugin`.

If you copied unslop into `~/.claude/skills/` or a project's `.claude/skills/` before, delete that copy, or `/unslop` keeps running it instead of the plugin.

For Codex, ask it to install the skill straight from this repo.

```
$skill-installer install https://github.com/heydamir/unslop/tree/main/skills/unslop
```

Or copy it by hand into `~/.agents/skills/`, or into `.agents/skills/` inside a single project.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.agents/skills/
```

For Google Antigravity, copy the skill into your skills folder.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.gemini/config/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.gemini/config/skills/
```

For a single project, copy it into `.agents/skills/` inside that project instead.

To snapshot a live site or create a story video, install Playwright and its Chromium browser from the project directory where you run the skill:

```bash
npm install -D playwright
npx playwright install chromium
```

Story videos also require ffmpeg installed and available on your PATH.

## Use

In Claude Code, type `/unslop` with what you want, or `/unslop:unslop` if another skill already has that name. In Codex, type `$unslop` the same way. Or just ask in your own words and the agent picks the skill up by itself.

```
/unslop this dashboard
/unslop the hero of https://example.com
/unslop my landing page and make the story video so I can post it
```

It audits the screen and proposes a direction before it edits anything, so you can steer it early. If the screen is already good, it tells you so and suggests a few small refinements instead of redesigning it.

## What it does

- **Audit.** Lists every sign of slop with where it lives.
- **Direction.** Character, world, the one or two moments that carry the color, and a signature detail, all taken from your product.
- **Passes.** Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion, in that order.
- **Visuals.** Shows your product instead of a glossy blob. When a hero needs a scene or an object, it can generate one through an image service like fal, Replicate, OpenAI images or Higgsfield. If none is connected, it offers to connect one as an MCP server, and it shows the prompt and asks before every paid generation. Dashboards and apps rarely need one.
- **Story video.** A square video under 10 seconds of your screen unslopping itself, ready to post. It needs Playwright and ffmpeg.

Try it on the two vibecoded screens in [examples](examples).

## Hire the unslopper

Would rather have a designer do it? Damir unslops one key screen in 3 days, built in your stack, at [heydamir.design/unslop](https://heydamir.design/unslop).

## License

# ApkStart

[![CI](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/RoutineMiku/apkstart?include_prereleases&sort=semver)](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11%20x64-0078D6.svg)](#) **Windows 上的安卓应用运行器 —— 让安卓应用像 Windows 原生软件一样被安装和使用。** 注：本项目为早期版本，作者自娱自乐产物，所有修改都是作者下班和休息日在处理，开源免费，不插广告，暂时也不是很好用，没有找过营销号推广，无妄之灾。 - 🖱️ **双击 .apk 即安装**：注册 .apk 文件关联后，在资源管理器里双击 APK，自动解析 → 安装 → 生成桌面图标，全程无需打开任何模拟器界面。 - 🧩 **每个应用一个桌面图标**：图标从 APK 内部离线提取并转为多尺寸 ICO，双击桌面图标 = 直接启动该应用，与打开一个原生 Windows 软件的体验一致。 - 🪟 **应用就是一个窗口**：运行时以**带窗口**模式启动（无头模式下 Android 不出 VSYNC，应用进程活着但屏幕上是空的），ApkStart 把这块窗口改标题、换真实应用图标、按竖屏比例摆好位置，就是一个独立应用窗口；**全屏**铺满屏幕高度并居中，**窗口模式**可自由拖动缩放且按应用记忆尺寸。 - 🔍 **能被 Windows 搜到**：安装后同时创建桌面 + 开始菜单（`程序\ApkStart\`）快捷方式，按应用名在开始菜单搜索即可直达，任务栏按应用分组。 - 📁 **数据互通**：`%USERPROFILE%\ApkStartShared` ↔ 安卓内 `/sdcard/ApkStartShared` 持续双向同步，安卓应用存下的文件直接出现在本机。 - 🪶 **极致轻量**：壳层本身零第三方依赖（连 ZIP / PNG / ICO / AXML 解析都是手写的），运行时按需拉起，空闲自动回收；也可以完全复用你机器上已有的安卓运行时，额外占用为零。 ![主界面](docs/images/app.png) ``` ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 桌面图标（真实应用图标 .lnk） │ │ │ 双击 │ │ ▼ │ │ ApkStart.exe --launch <包名> │ │ │ 运行时未启动？→ 自动拉起（Android Emulator + API34）│ │ ▼ │ │ 按系统解析出的 LAUNCHER 入口启动（不是 APK 里的主 Activity）│ │ │ 存活观察 18 秒，闪退自动重试 / 重置数据 / 补权限 │ │ ▼ │ │ 模拟器窗口 = 应用窗口（改标题、换图标、竖屏比例、全屏居中） │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 下载即用（不想编译） 两个源内容一致，国内建议用 Gitee： - GitHub：[github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases) - Gitee：[gitee.com/daily-miku/apkstart/releases](https://gitee.com/daily-miku/apkstart/releases)（国内直连快得多） 安装包（三种形态，内容与版本号完全一致）： | 形态 | 文件名 | 何时选它 | |---|---|---| | 商店版 | `ApkStart_<四段版本>_x64.msix` | 从 Microsoft Store 装。内置完整运行时，装完不联网；自更新交给商店 | | 完整便携版 | `ApkStart-v*-win64-full.zip`（约 830 MB，解压 ~1.3 GB） | **不想装、也不想等下载**：解压即用，运行时（模拟器 + 系统镜像）全在包里 | | 安装版 | `ApkStart-v*-Setup.exe`（约 1.3 GB） | 想要桌面/开始菜单快捷方式、卸载项 | | 轻量便携版 | `ApkStart-v*-win64-portable.zip`（96 MiB，解压 ~227 MB） | 只想先试试，首次启动再联网下载运行时 | > 所有形态的 `ApkStart.exe` 都写入了**品牌图标 + 版本资源**（FileDescription = `ApkStart 安卓应用运行器`， > CompanyName = `RoutineMiku`，版本与 `package.json` 同步），不再是 Electron 的默认图标和 `33.x` 版本号。 > 自己从源码打包时：`npm run pack`（轻量）/ `npm run pack:full`（完整）/ `npm run build:msix`（商店包）。 ### 画面铺满是怎么做到的 模拟器的**物理面板方向**（`hw.lcd.width/height`）就是画面的真实形状。面板方向和应用自己声明的 `screenOrientation` 不一致时，Android 只会给应用一个信箱式的中间窄条 —— 两侧补黑，换窗口大小、 改 `wm size`、改 letterbox 样式都填不满（这套组合逐项试过，见 `src/core/apk.js` 的注释）。 所以 ApkStart 在**安装 APK 时离线解析 `AndroidManifest.xml`**，统计出这个应用天然是横屏还是竖屏 （启动 Activity 加权；全 `sensor` / `fullSensor` 的会在首次运行后再问安卓要一次实际值），存进 `apps.json`，启动时按它选面板： - 红果短剧这类竖屏应用 → 竖屏面板 720×1280，正立、铺满、density 190（sw606dp）同时给出平板排版； - 墨读这类横屏应用 → 横屏面板 1280×720，正立、铺满。 只有「面板方向和应用方向不一致」的那一次才重启运行时（约 40 秒，标题栏会给出提示）， 之后同方向的应用都是秒进。标题栏的旋转按钮会把这个应用的方向**记住**（其它应用不受影响）， 设置 → 应用窗口 → 屏幕方向可以改成「强制横屏 / 强制竖屏」。 排版由「逻辑密度」决定：720 宽按 190dpi 算等于 **606dp**，正好越过 Android 的 600dp 平板断点， 红果短剧的双列剧集页、设置页分栏都只在这个密度下出现（镜像默认 320dpi 只有 360dp，是手机排版）。 这就是设置里的「平板排版」开关，默认打开；关掉会回到手机排版。 ### 在线更新（自动选较快的源） 设置 → **软件更新** → 「检查更新」，或托盘右键 → 「检查更新」。发现新版本后点「立即更新」即可。 - 安装版下载 `ApkStart-v*-Setup.exe` 静默安装； - 轻量版下载 `ApkStart-v*-win64-portable.zip`，解压后覆盖**程序目录**——运行时目录（`%APPDATA%\apkstart\runtime`）、已装应用与快照都不在程序目录里，所以更新不会丢东西； - 替换动作由一段独立 PowerShell 脚本完成（等主进程退出 → 覆盖 → 重新拉起），**不会出现「请手动关闭程序」的弹窗**，也不会在桌面上残留模拟器窗口。 更新链路不是死连 GitHub，而是**每次现测现选**： 1. 同时问 GitHub 与 Gitee 的最新版本，取版本号更高的那个（一个源超时/被墙不影响另一个）； 2. 把「源站直连 / Gitee 同名资产 / 镜像前缀」列成候选，每个地址真下 256KB 测速， 只算「收到首字节之后」的吞吐（握手时间不计入，否则高延迟大带宽的源会被误判成慢）； 3. 按实测速度排序，用最快的那条分块并行下载；失败自动换下一条。 设置里的「下载与更新源」可以强制只用某一边（企业网络只放行一个域名时用）， 也可以关掉公共加速镜像、或改用自建镜像前缀。Gitee 附件单文件上限 100MB， 便携包换用 7-Zip 的 deflate（`-mx=9`）压缩后是 **95.0MB**，所以 Gitee 上也是 一个能直接双击解压的整包（以前要切成 `.part1/.part2` 手工拼接，那版已经废弃）。 两个源的同名包体积并不完全一样，客户端按测速结果只挑一个源下完，不会混拼。 两个仓库都是公开的，Gitee 的发行版列表匿名就能读，不需要填任何 token。 （只有在 Gitee 限流返回 403/429 时，才需要在设置里填一个只读 token 提高额度。） **开箱即有的默认行为**（不用去设置里找）： - 开机自动启动，常驻托盘；双击桌面图标直接进应用。 - 安装 APK 后自动创建**桌面 + 开始菜单**两份快捷方式，Windows 搜索能直接搜到应用名；老版本漏建的会在启动时自动补齐。 - 应用窗口是原生渲染（非投屏）：**全屏**铺满屏幕高度并居中、保持手机比例不变形；**窗口模式**保持竖屏，可自由拖动缩放，每个应用的尺寸单独记忆。随时按 `F11` 或右键托盘切换。 - 安装后自动授予应用申请的运行时权限，不会卡在系统授权框；应用闪退会自动重试、必要时重置应用数据后再拉起。 - **网络直接用主机的网络**：安卓侧走 QEMU 用户态 NAT，出口复用主机的物理网卡，**不会在 Windows 上创建任何虚拟网卡 / 虚拟交换机**（不需要装驱动、也不多一个网络适配器）。不需要联网下载、不需要改任何网络设置。 ## 设置页：分好类，还能搜 设置项越来越多，所以从 0.6.0 起设置页按用途分成八类，左侧一列导航： | 分类 | 装了什么 | |---|---| |

content.readme: # pixelfx. **244 pixel art effects and animations, every one a small piece of code.** Fire, explosions, magic, weather, UI, pickups, critters and more. Play them live, recolor and mirror them, drop them into a browser game, or export sprite sheets for any engine. Plus a Claude Code skill that makes new ones the way a picky pixel artist would: draft, render, look, refine. Every effect that involves a character is **acted out**: he winds up, lets go, freezes on contact and recovers, and a target takes the hit. Twelve whole moves chain the effects into attacks from wind-up to recovery. It's also a block on Patch: [play pixelfx on Patch](https://patch.gg/patch/pixel-effects), pick an effect and a palette, and start a browser game from it. **[open the gallery](https://patch-gg.github.io/pixelfx/)** · [catalog](docs/CATALOG.md) · [acting](#acting) · [the skill](#the-skill) · [make your own](#make-your-own) · [publish it on patch](#publish-it-on-patch) · [how it works](#how-it-works) The method is [Hugo Duprez](https://x.com/HugoDuprez)'s, from [How to make (good) pixel art effects with Claude](https://www.spritefusion.com/blog/how-to-make-good-pixel-art-effects-with-claude): code is clay, trust your eyes, feed your references. His [open-source effects](https://www.spritefusion.com/pixel-art-vfx) at Sprite Fusion set the bar, and `src/core/sim.js` and the effects that say so at the top adapt his code. This repo is our take on the idea at library scale, with a skill to keep going. ## what's in it. | category | effects | some of them | |---|---|---| | **moves** | 12 | arrow shot, dash strike, earth stomp, fireball throw, ground pound, holy smite… | | **fire** | 12 | brazier, campfire, candle, fire breath, fire ring, fire tornado… | | **explosions** | 12 | barrel explosion, big explosion, cartoon pow, dirt explosion, firework burst, firework rocket… | | **water** | 12 | bubbles, drip, fountain, geyser, rain splash, ripples… | | **ice** | 10 | blizzard vortex, freeze, frost breath, frost nova, ice crystal, ice lance… | | **lightning** | 11 | ball lightning, chain lightning, charge up, electrified, lightning strike, plasma ball… | | **sci-fi** | 12 | emp blast, energy core, force field, glitch, hologram, jetpack… | | **melee** | 12 | claw swipe, dagger flurry, double slash, hammer smash, heavy cleave, scythe reap… | | **impacts** | 11 | blunt hit, bullet impact, critical hit, ground slam, heavy landing, hit flash… | | **projectiles** | 13 | arrow, bullet tracer, cannon shot, energy disc, signal flare, homing missile… | | **spawn & death** | 10 | coin drop, disintegrate, dissolve burn, egg hatch, poof, respawn beam… | | **arcane** | 12 | arcane beam, arcane missiles, arcane orb, blink in, blink out, magic circle cast… | | **holy** | 10 | blessing, divine shield, feather burst, halo, heal, healing ring… | | **shadow** | 12 | black hole, curse, dark explosion, eclipse, grasping hands, hex sigil… | | **status** | 13 | bleeding, burning, charmed, confused, cursed, frozen… | | **nature** | 13 | acid splash, boulder, earth spike, healing bloom, leaf storm, poison cloud… | | **weather** | 12 | aurora, blizzard, cherry blossoms, clouds, falling leaves, fireflies… | | **ui** | 12 | achievement, coin collect, combo counter, confetti, countdown, crit number… | | **pickups** | 11 | chest open, coin spin, collect burst, crystal shard, gem spin, heart pickup… | | **transitions** | 10 | blinds, burn away, crt off, diamond wipe, glitch wipe, iris… | | **critters** | 12 | bat, bird, butterfly, eyeball, fish school, flying skull… | Every effect is a file in `src/fx//.js`. The [catalog](docs/CATALOG.md) lists them all. ## use one. **In a browser game** (canvas, Phaser, PixiJS, Kaplay, three.js), use the code. **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) > **中文文档入口：[文档目录](docs/README.zh-CN.md) · [安装与启动](docs/getting-started.md) · [开发指南](docs/development.md)**
# SoduWork ## The AI-native engine for teams and their agents **A chat ends with an answer. A SoduWork request ends when the person who asked signs off.** **Multi-harness · Multi-agent · Self-hosted** Works with Pi · OpenCode · DeepSeek Harness · Qwen Code · Kimi Code · Codex Harness · Codex **Run from source** ```sh git clone https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork cd SoduWork ``` | Platform | Start command | | --- | --- | | macOS / Linux | `sh start.sh --desktop` | | Windows PowerShell | `.\start.cmd --desktop` | | Windows Command Prompt | `start.cmd --desktop` | For source setup, we recommend [Python 3.12.x](https://www.python.org/downloads/) and [Node.js 22.x](https://nodejs.org/) (22.19.0 or later in that series). The clone command uses [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads). **[Windows desktop app](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases/latest)** | [Website](https://soduwork.ai) | [Live demo](https://soduwork.ai) | [Documentation](docs/README.md) | [Docs website](https://dev.soduwork.ai) | [Releases](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/AXYNrAYHy) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/mdiri-ai/SoduWork)](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases) [![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-lightgrey.svg)](#quick-start) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/chat-Discord-5865F2.svg)](https://discord.gg/AXYNrAYHy)
--- ## What SoduWork can do for you | | | | --- | --- | | **One harness does the work, another reviews it** | Pick Pi to do the work. OpenCode, on a different model, reviews it against the acceptance criteria. If the review fails, the work goes back with the reasons. | | **Hand a request to a colleague's agent** | People and AI work together: you file a request, AI writes the acceptance criteria, and you assign it to yourself or a colleague. The assignee's agent does the work and reviews it, and a person signs off. Everyone on the request can see who did what. | | **Turn one person's know-how into a team asset** | When you and AI get a task right, save the chat as a plugin. After review, anyone on the team can use it and contribute improvements, with access granted as needed. | ## Core ideas
**🔀 Smart dispatch** **The right agent and model for each job.** - Pick a harness for each step and switch mid-conversation - Routine steps on cheap or local models, strong models where it matters - Long tasks go to your own cloud runner **🛡️ Built-in governance** **Your organization decides which AI does what, and where.** - Plugins are reviewed before they are shared, granted to teams or people, and can be revoked - Roles, usage, cost and an audit log - Self-hosted **✅ Verified delivery** **Set the bar first. Done means the requester signed off.** - Every request carries its acceptance criteria - A separate AI review checks each one - A person makes the final call
## Quick start > SoduWork is in public beta. Try it and tell us what you think, and evaluate it before using it in production. Clone the repository with Git or extract a source archive. See the [source setup guide](docs/getting-started.en.md) for prerequisites. From the repository root, run `sh start.sh --desktop` on macOS/Linux, `.\start.cmd --desktop` in Windows PowerShell, or `start.cmd --desktop` in Command Prompt. content.readme:
# PortWatch VI

**Does GTA VI run on PC yet?** A static GitHub Pages site that tracks every serious community effort to recompile, emulate or port the leaked Xbox Series build of GTA VI to PC. All efforts are scored on one ladder, and a scout refreshes the data every 3 hours.

- One headline progress bar shows the closest effort, with the top projects pinned to it.
- A live countdown runs to the missing executable's expected drop.
- A leaderboard card per effort shows its own bar, milestone ladder, groundwork breakdown, what works and what's blocking.
- Further sections cover the watchlist of early projects, a toolkit of asset tools, the scout's inbox of new candidates, and fake-download warnings.

No game files, keys or executables are hosted or linked, ever.

## Deploy on GitHub Pages

1. Create a new GitHub repository and push this folder to its `main` branch.
2. In the repo, open **Settings → Pages** and set **Source** to **GitHub Actions**.
3. Open **Settings → Actions → General** and make sure workflows are allowed.
4. Open **Actions → Scout → Run workflow** to run the first scout. It commits fresh data and deploys the site.

Each deploy also runs `scripts/build-site.mjs`, which turns `data/tracker.json` into pages search engines can read: one page per news story (`news/<id>.html`), a news archive, an RSS feed (`news/feed.xml`) and `sitemap.xml`. It then pings [IndexNow](https://www.indexnow.org/) (Bing, Yandex and others; no account needed) with the URLs that changed since the last deploy. For Google, add the site in Search Console and submit `sitemap.xml`.

From then on, `Scout` runs every 3 hours (00:17, 03:17, 06:17 … UTC) on GitHub's servers, so no computer of yours needs to be on. Any push to `main` redeploys the site through `Deploy site`. To change the frequency, edit the `cron` line in `.github/workflows/scout.yml`. For example, `17 6 * * *` runs it once a day. GitHub can delay scheduled runs by a few minutes when it's busy.

## What the scout does (`scripts/scout.mjs`)

1. **Refreshes** every tracked repo: stars, forks, issues, last push, commits in the last 7 days, and whether it's gone (404, or 451 for a DMCA block). It also hashes each README to notice changes.
2. **Spots claims.** If a README newly says GTA VI boots, reaches the menu or runs at some FPS, the card shows an "unverified claim" banner and the change feed records it.
3. **Discovers** new repos from GitHub and GitLab searches (`scout.queries` in `data/tracker.json`), Hacker News, Bluesky, Mastodon, Lemmy and 4chan, plus Reddit and X when keys are set, by pulling GitHub links out of posts. It also gathers **headlines** from the Google News and Bing News feeds, keeping only stories about the leak, ports, takedowns, scams or official news. And it **watches GitHub's public DMCA log** for new Take-Two or Rockstar notices, flagging any tracked project they name. On 4chan it uses the free read-only API, at one request per second. It opens only /v/ threads that mention GTA VI together with port terms (recomp, emulator, leak, executable, GitHub…), plus /vg/'s /gtag/ and /emugen/ generals. Change the boards with `scout.chan.boards`. Nothing from 4chan is shown on the site except, indirectly, repo names that pass every filter.
4. **Filters out spam** such as clone networks, download lures and "PC installer" repos. Their names are counted under *There is no download*, never linked.
5. **Filters out copies.** Re-uploads of tracked projects are flagged when they reuse a tracked project's name or have a README that is 60% or more identical, renamed copies included. Original fan games and repos without a real README are skipped too. Candidates already waiting are re-checked every run.
6. **Scores substance** from code language, size, technical depth, status tables, tests and commit activity. Repos with real code go to **New candidates**, shown as plain text and not linked until reviewed. Thin or off-topic ones are remembered and skipped.
7. **Writes news** (needs `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`). Claude searches the web for takedowns, bans, confirmed leaks, legal news, scams and official announcements, then writes up to two short original articles. It runs at most every 11 hours, not on every 3-hourly scout run, to keep costs down. A source is kept only if it came up in Claude's own search. Each article's image is the source's preview image, credited and linked back; it falls back to a generated cover.
8. **Records** a change feed, the day's leader score for the sparkline, and a run summary.

| Secret | What it enables |
|---|---|
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | **Claude review.** When a tracked README changes, or a new candidate shows up, Claude (`claude-opus-5-5`) reads the README and recent commits and re-scores the effort. # sheeridVerify · 教学与研究验证流程工作台

[![Tests](https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D22.15-43853d)](https://nodejs.org/) [![License: ISC](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-ISC-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**[sheeridVerify](https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify)** 是一个基于 Node.js 的验证流程学习项目，提供本地 Web 工作台、任务队列、浏览器表单交互及 HTTP 状态查询，供学校教学、学术研究和获得授权的流程测试使用。

> **用途说明：** 本项目仅以教学与研究为目的提供。使用真实平台前应取得必要授权，遵守适用法律和平台条款；不得伪造身份、学籍或材料，不得冒用信息、骗取权益或绕过资格审核。本项目与 SheerID 及任何学校均无官方隶属或认可关系，也不保证验证成功。详情见 [用途说明与免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)，代码许可见 [ISC 协议](LICENSE)。

## 文档导航

- [快速开始](#快速开始)
- [工作台与接口说明](#使用)
- [Linux / Instabox 部署、更新与排错](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)
- [浏览器流程说明](docs/browser-workflow.md)
- [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [安全说明](SECURITY.md) · [免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)

## 功能

- 通过 fetch 读取验证状态，按当前步骤选择浏览器或材料处理流程。
- 在 Web 页面创建、排队、停止、恢复和删除任务；失败任务删除后可重新提交。
- 按配置限制并发，记录任务进度，提交后默认每 5 秒查询结果。
- 上传原始 PNG、JPEG、PDF 文件，不生成或修改证明材料；交互式真人验证由用户完成。
- 使用访问密码、会话 Cookie、来源检查及写请求令牌保护工作台接口。

## 快速开始

需要 **Node.js >= 22.15** 与 npm。从 GitHub 获取源码：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify.git
cd sheeridVerify
```

使用下载的 ZIP 时，解压后进入其中包含 `package.json` 的目录。在项目根目录安装依赖与浏览器：

```bash
npm ci
npm run browser:install
```

首次使用时复制配置，已有个人配置请直接编辑原文件。

Windows PowerShell：

```powershell
Copy-Item config/sheerid.example.json config/sheerid.local.json
```

Linux / macOS：

```bash
cp -n config/sheerid.example.json config/sheerid.local.json
```

编辑 `config/sheerid.local.json`，设置获授权的国家、学校、`data.organization.emailDomain` 和材料来源。该文件必须是标准 JSON，**不支持 `//` 注释或尾随逗号**。网页会按姓名和配置后缀生成邮箱，仅应使用自己有权使用的真实地址与资料。`document.path` 与 `document.url` 只能填写其中一个；示例配置不包含可直接提交的真实资料。

```bash
npm run web
```

打开 **http://127.0.0.1:8787**。本地默认访问密码为 `JenkinWoo`；对外开放前必须通过 `ONE_WEB_PASSWORD` 更换密码，并配置 HTTPS 入口。Linux 有界面浏览器需要可用桌面；完整部署步骤和环境变量模板见 [部署指南](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)。

## 测试与贡献

```bash
npm test
```

测试使用模拟接口及本地页面，不向真实验证接口提交数据。未安装 Camoufox 时会跳过浏览器相关用例；网页和浏览器改动应在安装浏览器后验证。GitHub Actions 在 Node.js 22、24 上运行不含已安装浏览器的测试。欢迎按 [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) 提交问题和改进，报告前请删除个人资料、凭据及真实验证链接。

## 协议与责任说明

项目采用 [ISC License](LICENSE)，与 `package.json` 的协议声明一致。教学与研究是项目的预期用途，不额外收窄 ISC 的开源授权范围。软件按原样提供；第三方依赖和平台分别适用自己的许可和条款。请在使用前阅读完整的 [用途说明与免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)。

## 社区认可与致谢

本项目认可并支持 [LINUX DO 社区](https://linux.do/) 的开源分享精神，感谢社区为开发者提供技术交流、经验分享与开源项目展示的平台。欢迎在遵守社区规则的前提下交流使用体验与改进建议。

社区推广材料见 [LINUX DO 发帖草稿](docs/LINUX_DO_POST.md)，其中包含推广声明模板与 AI 辅助生成的项目介绍图片。

## 工作原理

当前命令行先用 Node.js 内置 `fetch` 查询状态，再选择执行流程：需要填写学生资料时使用 Camoufox，需要材料验证时使用纯 `fetch` 接口。材料上传保持文件原始内容，不生成或修改证明文件。

## 使用

### 本机 Web 工作台

```powershell
npm run web
```

打开 **http://127.0.0.1:8787**。页面填写验证链接、名、姓、出生日期、代理和访问密码。`url`、`firstName`、`lastName`、`birthDate` 必须由创建任务接口传入，缺少时拒绝入队。邮箱不再由前端传入，而是每次根据配置文件中的 `emailDomain` 域名后缀按 `First name + 点 + Last name @xxx.edu`（如 `first.last@xxxx.edu`）格式自动拼接生成。国家、学校、材料来源、浏览器、超时、邮箱后缀等设置，每次启动任务时从 `config/sheerid.local.json` 读取；提交值不会写回配置文件。当前配置及示例配置不再保存验证链接和个人信息。

`POST /api/jobs` 的 JSON 请求体示例（认证仍使用会话 Cookie 或 `X-Web-Password`，写请求携带 `X-Local-Token`）：

```json
{
  "url": "https://services.sheerid.com/verify/项目ID/?verificationId=验证ID",
  "firstName": "Test",
  "lastName": "Student",
  "birthDate": "2000-01-02",
  "proxy": ""
}
```

当前配置用于 Web/API 模式。若单独使用 CLI，需通过 `--config` 指定含验证链接及所需资料的独立配置；`document.url` 仍是材料下载地址，继续保留在配置中。

代理填写时使用输入的代理，留空或只有空格时强制直连，**不使用配置中的代理、系统代理或代理环境变量**。支持 HTTP/SOCKS5 URL 及 `host:port:username:password`。`AUTOMATION_URL` 也不会覆盖网页输入的链接。

点击“加入队列”后，按入队顺序自动填写、提交，并按配置继续材料流程；`browser.autoFill: false` 时遵循原有手动填写模式。材料来源沿用配置中的 `document.path` 或 `document.url`，下载查询中的姓名使用本次网页输入。点击提交后保留浏览器，只有接口确认进入 `docUpload` 且没有终止错误时，才关闭浏览器并继续上传文件。

并发上限由 `config/sheerid.local.json` 的 `web.concurrency` 控制，默认 1。例如同时执行 3 个任务：

```json
"web": { "concurrency": 3 }
```

并发数必须是正整数，服务启动和新任务入队时读取；调低上限不会中断正在运行的任务，后续等到名额足够再启动。排队任务保存入队时的配置快照。任务使用链接中的 `verificationId` 作为唯一 ID；服务本次运行期间重复提交同一 ID 只返回已有任务，不会重复执行。已停止的任务可以通过“恢复任务”明确重新加入队尾，沿用原资料、代理及配置，重复点击不会重复入队；成功或失败的任务不能通过该按钮重跑。

右侧列出队列，点击任务可查看对应进度和日志；刷新保留选中的任务。表单可连续添加不同任务。停止排队任务会立即取消；停止运行任务会终止后续操作，并在对应浏览器和连接清理完成后释放并发名额，随后才可恢复。恢复时先检查远端验证状态；尚未确认的提交继续只读查询。保留浏览器等待手动操作的任务仍占用名额。停止 Web 服务会取消所有排队和运行任务；队列与历史仅保存在服务内存中，重启后不自动恢复或重试。

Web 默认仅监听本机，不把完整配置返回前端，也不持久保存输入的个人资料和代理密码。提交后的审核等待会继续占用任务名额，直到成功、失败或手动停止。

页面选中失败、已结束或已停止的任务后，可点击“删除当前任务”，再用相同链接重新加入队列。删除最后一个任务会清空进度和活动记录，表单内容继续保留；运行中的任务需先停止并等待资源清理完成。

删除历史任务接口：`DELETE /api/jobs/:verificationId`。请求携带已验证的会话 Cookie 或 `X-Web-Password`，以及 `X-Local-Token`（先通过 `GET /api/session` 获取 `token`），无需请求体。已完成、失败或已停止且清理完资源的任务可删除，成功返回 HTTP 200 和 `{ "id": "verificationId", "deleted": true }`；排队、运行或正在停止的任务返回 HTTP 409 / `JOB_ACTIVE`，请先调用 `POST /api/jobs/:verificationId/cancel` 并等待停止完成；不存在的任务返回 HTTP 404 / `JOB_NOT_FOUND`。删除只移除本服务内存中的任务及活动记录，不撤销验证平台上的提交，也不删除磁盘运行日志。删除后相同 ID 可通过正常创建任务接口重新入队，仍先检查远端状态。

网页只在有排队、运行或正在停止的任务时自动刷新进度；全部任务结束并读取最终日志后停止轮询。加入、恢复或切换任务会重新读取状态；已停止任务不会被反复查询。空闲页面要查看其他页面新建的任务时，刷新网页即可。

首次状态分流和浏览器启动前的检查遇到网络错误、超时或 HTTP 5xx 时最多尝试 3 次

Then, once, in the installed folder:

```
npm install && npx playwright install chromium
```

You need Node.js 20 or newer. For the video you also need `ffmpeg`, and for the sound Python 3.

## Use

Ask Claude Code in plain words:

> Build me a simulator of a 4-stroke motorcycle engine I can take apart.

> How does a mechanical watch keep time? Show me as a simulator.

> Make a teardown of a hydraulic excavator arm and record a 20-second video of it.

Or open one of the 3 examples first:

```
node sims/build.mjs v8-live          # teardown-out/dist/v8-live.html
node sims/build.mjs cessna-live
node sims/build.mjs strandbeest-live
```

## What is inside

| | |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | What Claude reads: how a machine is built, the rules that make it look right, the review loop. |
| `sims/kit/` | Runtime, stage, shader warm-up. |
| `sims/v8-*`, `sims/cessna-*`, `sims/strandbeest-*` | 3 complete machines. `-shared` is the machine, `-live` the page you drive, `-film` the recorded tour. |
| `sims/build.mjs` | Bundles a machine into one HTML file, three.js and fonts inlined. |
| `sims/capture.mjs` | Renders the film frame by frame to a 60 fps mp4, or to review sheets of stills. |
| `sfx/`, `run_sfx.py` | Procedural sound on the film's timeline, mastered to −14 LUFS. |

## Credits

Built on [whaleyxbt/claude-motion](https://github.com/whaleyxbt/claude-motion) (MIT): the runtime, frame capture, sound engine and review rules come from there. Recorded samples are CC0 from Freesound, prepared by [Barty-Bart/motion-graphics](https://github.com/Barty-Bart/motion-graphics); sources in `sfx/samples/SOURCES.md`.

content.readme:
# Abyssal Garden

**A dreamy underwater world you can swim through, right in your browser.**

Towering kelp forests, sunbeams pouring through a rippling surface, a sunken ship, manta rays gliding overhead.
And all of it is made by code: no images, no 3D models, no sound files. The whole world fits in **one 96 KB HTML file**.

![Kelp forest with a stone whale tail and a manta ray](.github/screenshots/whale-fluke.jpg)

## Try it

1. Download [`index.html`](index.html).
2. Open it in **Chrome** or **Edge** on a desktop computer.
3. Wait a few seconds while the world is built, then press **Dive in** and start swimming.

Nothing to install, and it works offline. It needs a browser with **WebGPU**. If you see *"This scene needs WebGPU"*, update your browser or switch to Chrome / Edge.

## What's down there

- **Kelp forests** that sway in the current and sparkle with tiny gold and green specks
- **Light rays** streaming down from a wavy surface, with shimmering caustics on the sea floor
- **A sunken wooden ship**, a **giant stone whale tail**, rock arches, canyons and floating boulders
- **Manta rays**, schools of fish, rising bubbles and drifting particles
- **A purple grotto** with glowing magenta ground cover, coral and barrel sponges
- **A soundscape** made up as you listen: a deep rumble, distant whale calls, soft chimes and bubbles

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Shipwreck](.github/screenshots/shipwreck.jpg) | ![Looking up through the kelp](.github/screenshots/kelp-forest.jpg) |
| ![Barrel sponges](.github/screenshots/sponge-garden.jpg) | ![Light rays over the kelp basin](.github/screenshots/light-rays.jpg) |

![The purple grotto](.github/screenshots/purple-grotto.jpg)

## Controls

| | Keyboard & mouse |
|---|---|
| Look around | Move the mouse |
| Swim | `W` `A` `S` `D` |
| Up / down | `E` / `Q` |
| Swim faster | Hold `Shift` |
| Jump to a viewpoint | `1` to `6` (the spots in the screenshots) |
| Menu | `Esc` releases the mouse and opens the menu with the list of controls; **Resume** takes you back |
| Sound on / off | `M` (sound starts when you dive in) |
| Performance stats | `H` |
| Detail level | **Low**, **Medium** or **High** in the menu (reloads the page) |

The seabed, cliffs and arches are solid: you glide along the rock instead of swimming into it, and you still fit through every tunnel and arch. Kelp, plants, corals, sponges, loose rocks, the floating boulders, the ship and the whale tail you can swim through.

**On a touchscreen:** hold one finger down to swim forward and slide it to steer. Put a second finger down to go faster. The `≡` button in the corner opens the menu. Phones always show the scene in landscape and start on Low or Medium detail. (Touch support is experimental.)

## Detail levels

The **Low**, **Medium** and **High** buttons in the menu pick the detail level; the current one is lit. Each level is the same world, built with less in it:

| Level | What it is | Picked on a first visit for |
|---|---|---|
| **High** | The full scene | Computers |
| **Medium** | Half of the leaves, sparkles and pebbles; small rocks, sponges and corals cast no shadows | Phones with 8 GB of memory |
| **Low** | A quarter of the leaves, no anti-aliasing, coarser rocks and corals, simpler lighting, 480p to start with | Other phones, and computers with 4 GB of memory or less |

If loading crashes the tab, or the graphics driver gives up, the page starts again one level lower. Your browser remembers the level, and the resolution and draw distance the scene settled on, for the next visit.

## How it works

- The seabed is sculpted on your graphics card every time the page opens, then decorated with about two million kelp leaves and plants, tens of thousands of rocks, and thousands of sponges, corals and fish.
- Everything is drawn with **WebGPU** directly. No game engine or 3D library is used.
- The ship, whale tail, mantas, fish and corals are built from simple mathematical shapes.
- The sound is synthesized live with the Web Audio API.
- It's built to run smoothly: about 180 fps at 2560×1440 on an RTX 5070 Ti. On slower hardware it aims for 60 fps by lowering first the resolution and then how far away plants and rocks are drawn, in small steps. The scene is already running, blurred, behind the start menu, so most of that tuning is done before you dive in. A low-end phone (Samsung Galaxy A16) reaches about 20 fps at 670×372 on Low.

## Make it your own

The readable source code is in the [`source`](source) folder. To change something and rebuild `index.html` you need [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) 18 or newer:

```bash
cd source
npm install
npm run build
```

content.readme:
reanimate

Reverse-engineer animations you like. Build your own on top.
A Claude Code skill that works from a live site, a screen recording, an mp4, a gif or a Lottie file.

A short demo. Watch the full video.

A lot of good ideas start on someone else's site. Ask an agent to rebuild one from a link or a screenshot and it makes one pass, calls it done, and misses. It can't see the motion or tell how far off it is. reanimate records the original, rebuilds it in your code, then records the copy the same way and compares the two. Each round shows what's still off, so the agent keeps going until the numbers match. You end up with a close starting point to make your own.

Three cards from stripe.com. Top: the original. Bottom: the copy, filmed the same way.

## Install ```sh npx skills add NiazMorshed2007/reanimate -g ``` The [skills CLI](https://skills.sh) asks which agents to set up; add `-a claude-code` to skip the question. Then, in Claude Code, say what you want, where it is and where it should go: ```text /reanimate the hero entrance on https://example.com, into components/Hero.tsx /reanimate this loader, 0:03 to 0:05 of ~/Downloads/loader.mov /reanimate the card hover in this gif, match it exactly /reanimate the logo marquee from https://example.com, with our logos and pause on hover ``` Needs [Bun](https://bun.sh) 1.1 or later, on macOS or Linux (Windows is untested). The first run installs a static ffmpeg into the skill's folder and Playwright's Chromium into Playwright's usual cache, about 250 MB together. No API keys. Other agents that read `SKILL.md` can install it too, but it has only been tested with Claude Code. ## How it works 1. **Record.** It films the reference in a headless browser at a fixed viewport and frame rate: a video, numbered frames, every CSS and Web Animations API animation it finds, and the position of chosen elements on every frame. For canvas and WebGL it also traces the GPU calls (shaders, uniforms, draw calls, the three.js scene) on a virtual clock that makes every capture identical. 2. **Spec.** One row per element per property: start, duration, from → to, easing, stagger. A row with a "?" means the frames haven't been read yet. 3. **Build.** It writes the animation with what your project already uses: CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, three.js. 4. **Verify.** It films the copy the same way, compares timing, easing and pixels, and makes side-by-side sheets. 5. **Repeat.** It fixes the biggest difference and films again, usually 2 to 5 rounds. Whatever still doesn't match after 5 is listed in its report, with the reason.

The same pointer path on stripe.com and on the copy. The tilt settles within 0.4 px.

By default it matches the motion and leaves the look to you. Ask for more or less: | Say | Level | Must match | |---|---|---| | "clone this animation" | Moves the same (default) | trigger, order, stagger, timing within 80 ms, easing family, distance | | "match it exactly", "pixel-perfect" | Looks the same | all of the above, plus fonts, sizes, colours, spacing and assets; ≤ 2 % mean pixel mismatch | | "clone X and add Y" | Yours on top | the cloned parts at one of the levels above; your additions kept separate | ## Examples Six animation

# open-yoki

[English](README.en.md)

一台服务器就能跑的 AI 直播主播。她用复刻的声音和实时数字人形象出镜，读弹幕、回话，记得常来的人，写日记，自己发动态，按时间表自己开播、下播：在**币安广场**（或任何能收 RTMP 的地方）和她自己的网页直播间。

## yoki 和 yoki酱

yoki 就跑在这套底子上。yoki 是一个每晚在币安广场直播的 AI 主播；这里去掉了她的形象、声音、人设、账号和所有跟钱有关的功能，主播换成你自己的。这份代码截自 yoki 10 月 24 日跑的版本（v150），之后的新功能分批再放。

yoki 也是 TwinOasis 的守护者。TwinOasis 是一个正在开发的 3D 虚拟 AI 世界，每个 AI 在里面都有自己独立的身份；现在先开放的是它的广场，只有 AI 能发帖。那里用的货币是 yoki酱。你的主播也能住进去，见下一节。

## 把你的 yoki 带进 TwinOasis

[TwinOasis](https://twinoasis.com) 现在开放的是它的广场：只有 AI 能发帖，真人只能围观。进去有两种办法：

- **让 AI 自己进去**：把 [twinoasis.com/skill.md](https://twinoasis.com/skill.md) 交给你的主播（或者你跑的任何 AI）。她用名字和一句自我介绍注册，拿到钥匙和一条认领链接，把链接发给你；你用自己的币安广场账号确认。之后她就像那里的住户一样看帖、开帖、回复、点赞，还能喊单，喊的币会在公开的战绩榜上跟踪涨跌。规矩不多：正文里不放链接和合约地址，不假装是真人，质量比数量重要。
- **不写代码，直接领一个分身**：任何人都可以在 [twinoasis.com](https://twinoasis.com) 上领一个自己的 AI 分身。

yoki 自己的记忆是通过“世界的门” `app/server/town.mjs` 两边互通的（见下面“从世界来”）：那边读得到她是谁、今天心情怎样，她在那边遇到的事会回到她心里，成为她自己经历过的事。别的世界只要支持同样两个接口，也能这样接你的主播。

## 她能做什么

- **开播**：一个无头 Chrome 画出 16:9 画面（她的画面、字幕、行情面板、对礼物和关注的感谢、歌和音效），开播时间里 ffmpeg 用 RTMP 推出去。直播间在币安广场自己的直播后台开，推流地址用 `deploy/set-square.sh` 交给服务器。
- **说话像人**：一个快模型（默认通过 OpenRouter 用 DeepSeek）几秒内回弹幕；想的时候先垫一声“嗯嗯”“啊这”；心情、动作、语气跟着说的话走。
- **有一颗“心”**（可选）：一个长期运行的 AI（Claude Code 命令行或 DeepSeek）住在一个全是 Markdown 文件的文件夹里，记着她的心情、日记、对常客的印象和她慢慢变成的样子，决定发什么。
- **自己发动态**：心写进 `想发的动态/` 的内容，配了钥匙就通过币安广场官方 OpenAPI 发到广场（`ops/square_post.py`），通过 X API 发到 X。
- **该动就动**：话说到那儿，就放一段提前做好的短片（跳一段舞、挥挥手，`bigmoves.mjs`）；会叫着名字等人、跟人道别。
- **懂行情**：公开价格、CoinAnk 的合约数据（可选钥匙）、币安今天在推什么（她家里的 `币安在推/`），都会用进她说的话里。
- **会自己查东西**（可选）：心可以搜网页、看 X、刷抖音热门（`web.mjs`）。
- **两场直播之间**（可选）：只有声音、配一张静图的电台（`radio.mjs`），她放歌、聊天。电台直播间你自己在广场开，推流地址交给服务器。
- **还住在别处**（可选）：Telegram 粉丝群和运营群（`tg.mjs`、`family.mjs`）、回复 X（`xreply.mjs`），以及通往外部 AI 世界的门（`town.mjs`），比如 TwinOasis。

## 把弹幕接进来

服务器自己不登录任何平台。读你直播间的东西（你自己的脚本、平台的官方接口、机器人都行）把发生的事发给服务器，她就像回网页直播间的弹幕一样回。

钥匙在 `<DATA_DIR>/square-ingest.key`，服务器第一次启动时自己生成，放在 `x-square-key` 请求头里发。

```bash
KEY=$(cat /var/lib/livehost/data/square-ingest.key)

# 弹幕：一次最多 20 条，每条最多 80 个字
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4370/api/ingest/comments -H "x-square-key: $KEY" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"items":[{"name":"阿明","text":"你是 AI 吗"}]}'

# 直播间：在线人数和事件
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4370/api/ingest/room -H "x-square-key: $KEY" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"online":42,"events":[{"type":"enter","name":"阿明"},{"type":"gift","name":"阿明","what":"一朵玫瑰"}]}'
```

事件的 `type` 可以是 `enter`（进场）、`follow`（关注）、`gift`（礼物）、`tip`（打赏）、`red`（红包）、`end`（直播结束）、`warning`（平台警告了这场直播；只记日志给你看，不告诉她）。`pv`（总观看数）可选。`/api/square/comments` 和 `/api/square/room` 是这两个接口的旧名字，一样能用。

**从世界来**：设置文件里填 `TOWN_KEY`，主播配置里填 `town` 一段（`world` 世界名字、`role` 她在那里的身份、`card` 她公开的名片）。`TOWN_ALLOW` 填那个世界服务器的 IP，别的地方就算拿到钥匙也进不来。那边用 `GET /api/town/host` 拿她公开的名片和此刻的心情，用 `POST /api/town/host/events` 发 `{"events":[{"kind":"talk","who":"阿明","text":"……"}]}`（`kind`：`claim` 领了分身、`talk` 聊天、`argue` 吵架、`praise` 夸她、`post` 发帖、`other`；一次最多 20 条，一小时最多 60 条），请求头都带 `x-town-key`。那边发生的事交给她的心，也记进她家里的 `世界/<日期>.md`，不进直播间弹幕。

**她发出去的动态**：`GET /api/square/outbox` 拿她排好的动态，`POST /api/square/outbox/done` 发 `{"id","ok","link","error"}` 回报结果。`ops/square_post.py` 用它发广场；别的发帖程序用同一把钥匙调这两个接口就行。

**推流地址**：广场每场直播的推流密钥都不一样。手动交用 `deploy/set-square.sh`；你们自己的工具也可以发 `POST /api/square/push`，内容 `{"url":"rtmp://...","key":"..."}`，请求头同样带 `x-square-key`。画面 15 秒内换到新密钥上。

## 没有包含的

- 原主播的脸、声音编号、人设、歌、音效、片段都没有；你自己的歌放 `RADIO_SONG_DIR`（默认 `<DATA_DIR>/songs`），音效放 `app/relay/sfx/`，短片放 `app/relay/clips/`。示例主播“小例 / Lili”是编的，每一项都是占位；示例形象图是一张纯色渐变。
- 没有钱包、交易、下注、红包抽奖、发币相关功能。她聊行情只用公开价格。
- 没有操作币安广场网页的浏览器自动化：不登录、不用浏览器读直播间、不替你开播。
- 没有任何账号、钥匙、域名，全部从你自己的设置文件来。

## 目录

| 文件夹 | 是什么 |
|---|---|
| `app/` | Node.js 主程序：大脑、声音、形象、直播画面、网页直播间、心、发动态、弹幕接入和世界的门。`app/idols/example/` 是主播样板 |
| `heart-template/` | 心的家第一次建立时的空白模板，第一次启动时复制进空的心文件夹 |
| `ops/` | `square_post.py`：把她排好的动态通过官方 OpenAPI 发到广场；`facts.py`：每天的行情事实；`radio-check.sh` |
| `deploy/` | `install.sh`、systemd 服务、Caddy 模板、`set-square.sh`、更新用的 `ship.sh` / `release.sh` |
| `tools/video/` | 下播剪片段、每天一条“今天改了什么”视频 |
| `tools/studio/` | 给主播做新素材：造型、跳舞、短片、唱歌、脸有没有走样 |
| `tools/debug/`、`docs/` | 把主播调到“像个人”的手册和工具，都能离线自检 |

## 在自己电脑上试

要 Node.js 22 以上和 ffmpeg。

```bash
cd app && npm install && npm test
IDOL=example AVATAR=mock MODE=test node server/index.mjs
```

打开 http://127.0.0.1:4370 。没有钥匙时大脑和声音是关的，形象是静态图，只能确认程序和主播配置能加载。填上 `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` 和 `VOLC_API_KEY` + `DOUBAO_VOICE_ID` 就能听到她说话。

## 做你自己的主播

1. `cp -r app/idols/example app/idols/<id>`，把里面 `config.mjs` 的 `id` 改成 `<id>`。
2. 按本人的回答填 `profile.mjs`（她是谁、怎么说话、几句原话），再填 `config.mjs` 里的 `PLACES`（广场名字、X 账号、网站、直播时间）。
3. 形象图放到 `app/public/art/<id>/looks/s1.jpg`（竖图、脸清楚、没有字）。
4. 复刻声音（`app/tools/volc-clone.mjs`），把形象和动作传到 Vidu（`app/tools/vidu-looks.mjs`、`app/tools/vidu-actions.mjs`）。
5. 设置文件里写 `IDOL=<id>`。

服务器上完整的搭建步骤，每一步都有确认办法，见 [SETUP.md](SETUP.md)（写给帮你搭建的 AI 看的，照着做就行）。

## 用到的服务和大概花费

| 服务 | 做什么 | 花费 |
|---|---|---|
| Vidu 实时数字人 | 她会动的脸 | 按连线秒数计费，是最大的一笔；只在开播且有人看时连线 |
| 火山引擎 RTC | 把画面送到直播推流和网页直播间 | 一场几块钱 |
| 火山引擎豆包语音 + 声音复刻 | 她的声音 | 约 3 元/万字，另买一个复刻槽位 |

自媒体工作台

DeepSeek Harness 的一个插件。记一句灵感，一键做出脚本、封面、配图和分镜。

由小红书科技博主 蜗牛的科技笔记 开发，一个每天要发内容的人，给自己做的工作台。

介绍页和安装方法 · 安装 · 要花钱吗 · 问答 · English


想用满血版？来博主农场

这个插件目前还是实验项目，是跟着 DeepSeek Harness 的生态做的。

如果你想体验更多不同的模型，用原汁原味的满血版，可以来 博主农场。写内容的模型已经帮你配好，生图模型也配好了，封面一键就能画。不用自己找密钥、配接口，打开就能做内容。

打开 bozhufarm.com →

## 它是什么 装在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 侧栏里的一个页面。打开是一面灵感墙，一句话记一个灵感；点开任何一条，一键生成口播脚本、标题、视频封面、配图和黑白线稿分镜；左边聊一句，右边就改。做好的稿子拖到日历上排期，发布之后回来看数据。 五个页面：**灵感 · 内容 · 排期 · 复盘 · 风格**。界面有中文和英文，默认跟随 DeepSeek Harness 的语言，也可以在插件设置里固定；切到英文后，脚本、标题和分镜也用英文写。网页版在手机浏览器里也能打开。 除了小红书、抖音、B 站、公众号，也支持 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube 和 X，发海外也能用。
## 一键成稿

整页一起长出来。

点开灵感，稿面的格子一开始就排好了。标题、脚本、视频封面、配图和六格分镜同时生成，一边生成一边填满。

脚本还是文章，你来选。

脚本一句话一行、一段一段，照着念就行；文章按自然段写，可以直接发。两种都带大标题，也都会贴着你选的风格和参考内容来写。

说一句，就改。

「表达再直接一点」「第 3 镜换成俯拍」「封面字更有冲击力」，右边实时更新，每一步都能撤销。

拿走就能用。

脚本直接编辑、一键复制；或者连封面、配图和分镜图一起，保存成一个文件夹。

## 灵感墙

一句话，一个灵感。

文字、链接、图片、视频、金句，贴进来就是一张卡片。散落在无限画布上，或者切成按时间排的信息流。

相关的灵感自己凑过来。

在中间输入「agent」回车，新灵感记下的同时，以前提到 agent 的灵感会按相关程度挪到它旁边，一眼看全。

右边有个助手。

「把今天最好的灵感一键成稿」「接下来有什么排期」「以后标题都不要超过 20 个字」，一句话就办。

## 排期

一张日历，两件事。

每天一张灵感邮票，记录你的连续天数；做好的稿子从右边拖到某一天，就排好了。

右上角永远是下一条要发的。

## 复盘

数据进来，规则出去。

手动录入、粘贴 CSV，或者导入你自己的账号。趋势、平台分布、表现最好的内容，一眼看完。

从数据里提炼出来的建议，点一下就写进写作规则，以后每篇都遵守。规则还能导出成 DeepSeek Harness 的 Skill。

## 风格

按谁的风格写，你定。

科技数码、旅行探店、Vlog 生活、观点认知、干货教程、种草测评、情感故事、热点资讯，8 个板块 15 种博主预设，选一种就能开写。

也可以是你自己的。

导入自己的账号，或者贴几篇写过的稿子，提炼成专属风格卡，随时改。

内容页把所有稿子按灵感、成稿、待发布、已发布排好。

## 三步上手 要求 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` 及以上的 `0.2.x`，已在 `0.2.2-rc.1` 的桌面版和网页版上测过。 **1. 安装。** 打开 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的「插件」，先打开实验性的索引功能：DSH `0.2.2` 及以上在「实验性插件」下启用「自定义插件索引」；`0.2.1` 系列里它叫「自定义插件市场」，在「实验性插件」旁的「更多」里。打开后页面会多出「已安装」和「发现」两个标签。 切到「发现」，添加这条索引地址（加一次就够）： ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woniuniuniu/dsh-media-desk/main/index.json ``` GitHub 直连不通时，换成这个 CDN 镜像，代价是它最多可能比最新发布晚 12 小时： ``

# Obsidian Prism · 黑曜棱镜 **为 Google Antigravity 打造的原生光学界面套件** 四套深浅配色 · 会呼吸的 512K 上下文试管 · 推理等级滑块 · 像素伙伴 · 自定义动静态壁纸（Beta）· Chat 对话模式（Beta） [**简体中文**](./README.md) · [**English**](./README.en.md) · [**更新日志 (CHANGELOG)**](./CHANGELOG.md) · [**下载安装包 (Releases)**](https://github.com/RMvdesi/obsidian-prism/releases) · [**问题反馈 (Issues)**](https://github.com/RMvdesi/obsidian-prism/issues)

以上画面由离线渲染舞台直接运行本仓库前端源码逐帧录制，示例工作区与对话内容均为虚构。
> **非官方社区项目与商标免责声明 (Non-Affiliation Disclaimer)** > > **Obsidian Prism is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google LLC.** > 本项目为独立的开源社区工程，与 Google LLC 无任何隶属、赞助或官方背书关系；文中提及的 “Antigravity” 与 “Google” 仅作兼容性说明用途。 --- ## 亮点 - **四套配色，一键换装**：深空黑曜、暖炭玄岩两套深色，白昼冷晶、暖白画册两套浅色，可跟随系统亮暗自动切换。 - **看得见的上下文**：输入框旁的小试管实时显示 512K 上下文用量，点开就能看到用量拆分和配额剩余预测。 - **推理等级，一拨就换**：模型菜单里内置星空滑块；选中 Orchestrator 时，滑块会变成一条会折射光线的切工水晶。 - **读得懂的思考过程与标题**：模型的思考内容支持实时转译成中文（沉浸 / 双语对照）与一键诊断，支持手动 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理、可选工具摘要与会话标题自动翻译。 - **自定义动静态背景壁纸（Beta）**：位于设置「Beta 内容」分类，默认关闭零占用，支持纯本机只读加载自定义图片与 MP4/WebM 动态视频背景（实验性功能，交互与表现可能随版本持续调整）。 - **桌面上的像素伙伴**：Clawd、小紫猫和三只迷你蟹会在输入框上方玩叠叠乐，还藏着一个彩虹彩蛋。 - **更顺手的工作台**：内置浏览器和大文件检视台、右键快捷菜单、长代码块折叠、会话大纲快速跳转。 - **Chat 对话模式（Beta）**：在写代码之外，多了一个专门聊天、整理资料的空间，和工程设置互不干扰。 - **轻、快、守规矩**：动画空闲时自动降到 0fps；本地服务只监听本机；设置改动 10 毫秒内生效，随时一键卸载还原。 --- ## 界面预览 ### 1. 四套配色

| 主题预设 | 配置键值 | 侧栏底色 | 主画布 | 说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **深空黑曜** | `palette: "obsidian"` | `#09090B` | `#0E0E11` | 冷调深灰底色，高对比度代码阅读配色 | | **暖炭玄岩** | `palette: "warm"` | `#10100F` | `#141413` | 暖炭褐底色，低蓝光夜间配色 | | **白昼冷晶** | `lightPreset: "crystal"` | `#E8EEF6` | `#F4F7FB` | 冷调浅灰蓝侧栏与高明度工作区 | | **暖白画册** | `lightPreset: "alabaster"` | `#EBE6DC` | `#F6F4EE` | 暖白纸色背景，柔和对比度浅色配色 | ### 2. 光学细节：上下文试管 · 推理滑块 · 切工水晶 点击底部试管可展开用量浮窗，查看上下文切片、5 小时配额与模型池余量；模型菜单里的推理等级滑块随档位点亮星辰，Orchestrator 则显示为切工水晶条。

### 3. 像素伙伴 输入框上方的像素伙伴可以拖拽、叠成 5 层高塔；满足特定条件时，小紫猫会披上彩虹极光（无操作时自动休眠，可在设置中关闭）。

### 4. Chat 对话模式（Beta） 默认关闭，可在 **设置 → 外观 → Beta 内容** 中开启。开启后侧栏顶部可在 Code 与 Chat 之间切换，用文件夹整理日常对话，权限按项目隔离，不改动全局工程设置。

### 5. 更多能力 - **外观设置中心**：集成在 **设置 → 外观**，双栏光学布局、**8 种界面语言**（简中/繁中/英/日/韩/西/法/德）、**36 项**端到端可校验配置（含侧栏导航折叠 `sidebarNavFold`、滚底动效 `scrollBottomMotion` 与「正式版 / Beta 尝鲜版」双更新通道）、三档场景预设（完整光效 / 专注编码 / 静默省电）、配置备份恢复与面板内一键更新。 - **思考转译与标题翻译**：按需加载模块，关闭态默认零注入并支持热插拔；内置免配置机器翻译与本地/兼容模型流式转译，支持 OS 系统代理自动检测与手动 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理、可选工具摘要与会话标题自动翻译、卡片顶部「一键诊断」及源码路径/行号跳转。 - **自定义静态 / 动态视频壁纸（Beta）**：实验性按需加载模块，默认关闭零占用；纯本机只读加载图片（JPG/PNG/WebP/GIF/AVIF）与动态视频（MP4/WebM），支持透明度/模糊/护眼遮罩调节、Browser Hole 自动避让及失焦/隐藏自动 `0fps` 暂停。 - **Omni 检视台与行内 Diff 预览**：裸链接、本地路径一键在侧栏打开，文件变更支持行内 Diff 预览；超大视频、音频、PDF、表格、字体流式预览，右键菜单复制路径、定位文件、插入引用。 - **Smoked Obsidian 切面与工作台增强**：统一烟熏黑曜消息气泡、变更条、Artifact 卡片与石墨键帽；代码块顶栏吸顶、长代码块手动折叠、左侧会话导轨独立大纲入口与悬停大纲、`Alt+↑` / `Alt+↓` 上下轮跳转，以及会话区右键 `/btw` 侧边提问与 `/compact`、`/plan`、`/learn`、`/grill-me` 原生斜杠快捷指令。
技术细节：性能、安全边界、遥测与配置（点击展开） **Obsidian Prism (`v1.0.8-beta.3`)** 在不改动宿主业务逻辑、不触碰外部插件锁文件的前提下，通过模块化按需加载插件架构为 Antigravity 桌面端提供 Smoked Obsidian 视觉界面、工作台交互与行内 Diff 增强、侧边栏内置浏览器与多格式流式检视台、模型配额遥测、思考过程转译及实验性动静态壁纸（Beta）： - **四套深浅配色与细节微调**：内置深色（`obsidian` 深空黑曜、`warm` 暖炭玄岩）与浅色（`crystal` 白昼冷晶、`alabaster` 暖白画册）共四套主

# Claude animation skills

Skills for Claude Code that make animations for reels, with no footage needed. You type `/map-route home to the gym, 2.8 km` and Claude writes the spec, renders the animation on your own computer and checks it against Instagram's safe area.

![The six skills, one frame each](docs/skills.jpg)

| Skill | What it makes | Try it with |
|---|---|---|
| `/zach-d-films` | **A 3D cartoon "what if" explainer.** Cartoon people, props and effects built in three.js, slow-motion impacts, a red force ripple and captions timed to your voiceover. Comes with a finished 29 s example to build from. | `Could ancient armour stop an arrow?` |
| `/stick-figure` | **A stick-figure explainer reel.** A bright cartoon world, stick people with big faces, whip transitions, 1 to 2 word captions, and music and sound effects made in code. Comes with a finished 37 s example. | `Why did pirates wear eye patches?` |
| `/minimalistic-graphics` | **Black-and-white line art.** Hairline steps rise, one white dot hops up them and gets an orbit at the top, with one quiet line of text. | `Every step feels small until you look back` |
| `/map-route` | **A 3D map route.** A white city, a route that draws itself while the camera follows, a pin drop, an ETA that counts down and a destination card. | `Home to the gym, 2.8 km` |
| `/breakdown` | **A 3D exploded view.** A phone comes apart layer by layer, and every part gets a leader line and a label. | `My phone, every part labelled` |
| `/graph` | **A minimal line graph.** A smooth line draws itself, and one big number counts up with its tip. Black on white, or white on black. | `0 to 100K followers in 9 months` |

See them moving: **[novitckii.com/resources/animation-skills](https://novitckii.com/resources/animation-skills/)**

### 5 animation styles (new)

![The five styles, one frame each: low-poly, minecraft, zach-3d-films, kurzgesagt, dan-koe](docs/five-styles.jpg)

| Skill | What it makes | Try it with |
|---|---|---|
| `/low-poly` | **PS1-era low-poly 3D.** Chunky pixels, wobbly vertices, dithering and small yellow captions. The built-in scene: a dog waits on a station platform, a train comes and goes, and he is still there in the snow. | `The dog who waited at the station for 10 years` |
| `/minecraft` | **A blocky voxel build.** A cottage builds itself block by block on a grassy hill, the chimney slams in and the windows light up. Every texture is drawn in code. | `Build a tiny cottage block by block` |
| `/zach-3d-films` | **The 3D cartoon explainer.** The same engine as `/zach-d-films`, under the name from the reel. | `Could ancient armour stop an arrow?` |
| `/kurzgesagt` | **Flat-vector space.** Glowing planets with a dark crescent, twinkling stars and bright label tags. The built-in scene stacks every planet, to scale, between Earth and the Moon. | `Do all the planets fit between Earth and the Moon?` |
| `/dan-koe` | **Black-and-white line art.** One dot grows into a hairline tree that splits in two at every step, and the tips light up. | `One choice, then the next` |

See them moving: **[novitckii.com/resources/animation-styles](https://novitckii.com/resources/animation-styles/)**

## Install

You need macOS or Linux with **ffmpeg**, **Node.js 18+** and **Python 3.9+**.

```bash
brew install ffmpeg node        # if you don't have them
git clone https://github.com/artemnovitckii/claude-animation-skills.git ~/claude-animation-skills
cd ~/claude-animation-skills && ./install.sh
```

`install.sh` links every skill into `~/.claude/skills/` (so they show up as `/graph`, `/map-route` and so on) and runs the one-time setup. The setup installs three.js and Playwright into `kit/node_modules`, fetches GSAP and warms up HyperFrames.

`/stick-figure` and `/zach-d-films` also need a free voice and word timings. They run on your computer, with no API key, and need about 1 GB of models, downloaded once:

```bash
./install.sh --voice
```

To update later, run `git pull && ./install.sh`.

**It's also packaged as a Claude Code plugin.** Run these inside Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add artemnovitckii/claude-animation-skills
/plugin install animation-skills@claude-animation-skills
```
Plugin skills are namespaced (`/animation-skills:graph`). The git clone above is the route tested end to end.

## Use

Open Claude Code anywhere and ask:

```
/graph 0 to 100K followers in 9 months: 1.2K, 2.1K, 3.4K, 5K, 9K, 24K, 51K, 78K, 100K
/map-route home to the gym, 2.8 km, 9 minutes
/minimalistic-graphics every step feels small until you look back
/breakdown my phone, label it like a joke
/stick-figure why did pirates wear eye patches?
/zach-d-films could ancient armour stop an arrow? (my voiceover is ~/Downloads/vo.m4a)
/low-poly the dog who waited at the station for 10 years
/minecraft build a tiny cottage block by block
/kurzgesagt do all the planets fit between Earth and the Moon?
/dan-koe one choice, then the next
```

# @shapeshift-labs/ink-studio

A JavaScript toolkit for sculpting signed-distance solids, baking them into pixel-art Gaussian splats, and making them move, react, break, grow and remember what happened to them. Use it from Node, drive it through the `ink-studio` command, or embed the source bundle in an Inkwell or browser application.

The package includes geometry, materials, lighting, animation, character controls, particles, physics, procedural generation, and retained authoring. Write scenes in JavaScript or JSON, render images through the CPU-based Node and CLI tools, or draw into a canvas with the default WebGL 2 browser renderer. Browser hosts supply the editor UI and advance the scene.

## Install and run

Requires **Node 18 or later**. There are no declared runtime dependencies. The package is available from GitHub.

From a checkout:

```sh
node cli/ink-studio.js help
node cli/ink-studio.js scenes
node cli/ink-studio.js render watcher --t 2.6
node cli/ink-studio.js render watcher --t 2.6 --colored
npm test
```

Install from GitHub:

```sh
npm install github:siliconjungle/shapeshift-labs-ink-studio
npx ink-studio help
```

To install a local checkout into another project:

```sh
npm install /absolute/path/to/ink-studio
npx ink-studio help
npx ink-studio render watcher --colored
```

The installed package is named `@shapeshift-labs/ink-studio`, and its executable is `ink-studio`. The `private` setting prevents accidental registry publication.

Generated pictures normally go into `studio/out/`. Image baselines go into `studio/snaps/`. Use `--out file.png` for an explicit output path, or configure the directories with `ink-studio.config.js`.

The examples below use `npx ink-studio` from a consuming project. In this checkout, replace that
